scope: Proposition 10.9 of the manuscript “The spacetime Penrose inequality with charge and original-data rigidity” (preprints/The-spacetime-Penrose-inequality-with-charge-and-original-data-rigidity-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 84ca5bc05bc907a1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 76. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix q2 ∈ (1/2, 1). There exists a smooth spacelike maximal hypersurface b Σ ⊂ e R with ∂ b Σ = B0, whose interior is Cauchy in R. Every complete Killing orbit of R meets it exactly once. In the harmonic rest chart of Proposition 10.6 its end is a graph t = f(x) satisfying f = O(ρ1−q2 ), ∂f = O(ρ−q2 ), ∂2 f = O(ρ−1−q2 ). (10.25) The graph has the corresponding higher differentiability and scaled Hölder estimates. Its Killing translates cover the right wedge.
